question: Which material was used to make beads in the Harappan civilisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carnelian stone**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Carnelian stone** was one of the primary materials used to make beads in the Harappan civilization.
 
• The Harappan civilization, also known as the Indus Valley Civilization, flourished around 2500 BCE in what is now Pakistan and northwest India.
